test_str_slice: test the polars str.slice method to extract substrings by offset and length from string columns
test_str_head: test the polars str.head method to get the first n characters from string columns
test_str_tail: test the polars str.tail method to get the last n characters from string columns
test_str_contains: test the polars str.contains method to match strings against regex or literal patterns
test_str_replace: test the polars str.replace and str.replace_all methods to substitute matched patterns in strings
test_str_split: test the polars str.split method to split strings by delimiter with optional inclusive and regex support
test_str_extract: test the polars str.extract method to capture regex groups from string columns
test_str_find: test the polars str.find method to locate the first occurrence of a pattern in strings
test_str_strip: test the polars str.strip_chars, strip_chars_start, and strip_chars_end methods to remove characters from strings
test_str_encode_decode: test the polars str.encode and str.decode methods for hex and base64 encoding and decoding
test_str_to_integer: test the polars str.to_integer method to convert string columns to integers with configurable base and dtype
test_str_json_decode: test the polars str.json_decode method to parse JSON strings into structs or lists
test_str_replace_many: test the polars str.replace_many method to replace multiple patterns with corresponding replacements
test_str_extract_groups: test the polars str.extract_groups method to extract named or numbered regex capture groups into a struct
test_str_split_exact: test the polars str.split_exact method to split a string into a fixed number of fields as a struct
test_str_splitn: test the polars str.splitn method to split a string into at most n fields as a struct
test_str_count_matches: test the polars str.count_matches method to count regex or literal pattern occurrences in strings
test_str_extract_all: test the polars str.extract_all method to extract all regex matches into a list column
test_str_starts_ends_with: test the polars str.starts_with and str.ends_with methods to check string prefixes and suffixes
test_str_normalize: test the polars str.normalize method to apply Unicode normalization forms like NFC, NFD, NFKC, NFKD
